title: Authorisation and money input evaluation fixture

acceptance_criteria.criterion: [AC-01] Given a valid card, when 2500 is authorised, then the amount is reserved and a balanced pair is posted
[AC-02] Given an authorised payment, when its stored record is inspected, then it carries only a token and the last four digits
[VAL-01] When a fractional minor unit is constructed, then it is rejected
